# Open questions — October 12,2026, analyst substitution challenge

1. Will H2 capex reach the held MSFT cash PP&E $83.322bn, GOOGL purchases $99.402bn, AMZN gross purchases $116.589bn and META inclusive capex $86.58bn? Late-October guides, identified delivery deferrals and offsets will test whether the provisional budgets need cuts.

2. What are Google’s internal TPU-versus-NVIDIA and AWS Trainium-versus-NVIDIA October–December hardware dollars, distinct from external TPU sales, service revenue and units? Named current procurement budgets at late-October results would test the held 65% annual NVIDIA split and realized mix.

3. Does the vendor’s four-cloud universe match MSFT/GOOGL/META/AMZN, and what is their actual share of NVIDIA revenue? A customer/order crosswalk plus November cohort disclosure would test provisional base concentration 44.55%.

4. Will NVIDIA Q3 FY27 Data Center reach $102bn and fiscal Q4 support own $127bn versus required $126.58bn? Expected November 18 results and monthly customer control-transfer schedules would separate October–December substitution from January; date confirmation and segment consensus remain missing.

5. What is recognized AMD Instinct revenue excluding EPYC, when do Meta/Azure Helios plans convert, and are any claimed under-5% AMD orders deferred? Early-November GPU-only disclosure and customer shipment dates would permit a variant from the retained $14bn anchor.

6. Will 2027 accelerator spending grow faster than total capex after separating fresh demand from rollover, and do AWS margins remain resilient? Named equipment/building budgets in late-October commentary and January-February guides, followed by Q1 receipts, would answer.

7. Are respondents independent across and within both Supply Chain Signals checks, and are the system values nonduplicated? Vendor methodology and matched order records before the November print would validate the evidence.

8. Which customers, campuses and orders have revised dates due to interconnects/transformers, and are power vendors discussing the same ODM orders? Named schedules and site power-ready MW before late-October reports, including sites within MSFT FY2027–33, GOOGL 2026–31 and META 2027–28 lease windows, would establish corroboration.

9. Do earlier stable 20–30 week neocloud lead times describe new orders or allocations, and are they relevant to these existing hyperscaler orders? A comparable follow-up check before November would distinguish procurement cadence from site-related slips.

10. When did NVIDIA transfer products to OEMs/ODMs, what invoice content is NVIDIA’s, and do actual contracts gate control on customer acceptance or energization? Terms and order-level supplier amounts before November would replace the assumed content/net-recognition weights.

11. What company capex measures and capture/quarter inputs actually drive the broker’s $385bn? A fuller model before November would reassess the wider $13.57bn gap after our timing revision.

12. What panel, weights, cutoff and calendarization produce the reported $376bn tracker? Methodology or a dated tracker before November would audit the benchmark we currently track.

13. How much gross system value was unpaid 2026 cash PP&E versus deposits, leases or already-recognized upstream products, and what offsets exist? Identified invoice/payment schedules and customer Q3 guidance would size a cash cut and prevent double counting with the realization proxy.

14. Were original supplier dates in October, November or December, and are deferred receipts in January, February or March? Month-level schedules before November would replace the equal-placement assumption and refine Q3, fiscal Q4 and calendar 2026 separately.

15. Which employer, plan vintage and current procurement cohort support the expert’s one-third estimate for the two unnamed clouds? Identifiable current plans with custom/total accelerator dollars and late-2027 versus annual scope before January-February guidance would distinguish extrapolation from a grounded share estimate.

16. How much of disclosed Trainium capacity and external TPU agreements converts into 2027 supplier hardware dollars, at what prices and energization dates? Company shipment/value disclosures in late-October results and 2027 guides would permit comparison with total capex; GW, units, service revenue and asset stocks alone cannot.

17. Which custom deployments replace previously intended NVIDIA purchases rather than add capacity, and do those orders overlap the already-modeled $3.19bn timing loss? Named order counterfactuals, hardware invoice values and Oct/Nov/Dec/Jan control-transfer dates before late-October/November reports would establish a net incremental cut.

Answered on stated scope: AWS custom production during 2026 and dated NVIDIA relationships with both customers are established. Google external TPU sales are separately identified; internal procurement, net substitution and monthly supplier recognition remain unresolved. All sixteen prior questions remain, with one question added on incremental substitution and overlap with the timing allowance.

Next independent session: none immediately; await late-October customer and November NVIDIA disclosures or named vendor order crosswalks. No new attention: the analyst's request is a hypothesis to test, not a directive to change65%; no guidance or settled decision exists. Previous vendor-crosswalk attention remains recorded without repetition.
